svg.text: Claude Code latest
New 18
Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool
call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells
Claude the result when it finishes
Added the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND environment variable to
make Claude Code wait for an MCP task inside its tool call instead of moving it to
the background right away
Added permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting setting: a tool call that would wait on
a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions,
subagents and teammates
Added /claude-api latency-optimize to find where your Claude API code
makes people wait and try faster settings against your eval
Added the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS environment variable, which
stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry; every flag then uses
its built-in default
Added spend for today, this week and this month to /usage for developers behind
a Claude apps gateway who have no spend limit, when the gateway runs this
version or later
Added admin.pooled_conflict_rule and admin.pooled_priority_order to the
Claude apps gateway, to set which pooled group budget pays first for a
developer in several groups
Added an optional login_notice setting to the Claude apps gateway that shows an
operator-defined message on the gateway's browser verification page and on
Claude Code's sign-in screen
Added CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json to the Claude apps gateway: operational
log lines become JSON with severity, time and message, for log collectors that
read the level from a field
Added a Claude apps gateway boot warning for a case where another policy's
availableModels also allows a custom model id that one policy lists by name
Added start-up warnings to the Claude apps gateway for policies with no
desktopHome that rely on coworkTabEnabled: false or
chatSessionRetentionDays, ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change
Added a warning when your claude.ai login ends and Claude Code continues on
the sign-in from ant auth login, which bills usage to your Claude Console
organization
Added a line at startup naming the Claude Console organization that is billed in a
case where Claude Code uses the sign-in from ant auth login
Added an "Earlier in this session" row to /tasks that lists finished subagents,
so you can reopen one and message it even after it leaves the list or you restart
Added a note to /loop confirmations in cloud sessions that a timer stops with its
container, with an offer of a loop that survives
Gateway: Added startup warnings for upstreams that mix AWS GovCloud with
other upstreams, and for base URL variables in the gateway's environment
Gateway: Added a start-up log warning when managed settings name an Amazon
Bedrock guardrail in a header, which the gateway doesn't forward, and no
bedrock upstream sets a guardrail
[Claude Tag] Added a Claude Tag row to the Models admin page for Enterprise
orgs with Claude Tag connected, linking to where its model defaults are managed
Improved 36
Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM
gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no
fallback to the built-in classifier; set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 to keep
using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1
turns on the server-side check even with
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS set; if managed settings set the latter,
they must set the 1 too
Improved config saves on Windows: Claude Code waits longer for a file another
program has open, so a kill during a save is less likely to leave ~/.claude.json
empty
Improved Claude in Chrome after a brief disconnect: it waits up to 6 seconds
for the session's own browser to return before picking another
Improved Claude in Chrome: javascript_tool results of up to 60,000 characters
now stay in the conversation instead of being saved to a file
Improved claude purge and the clean-up of old sessions to retry a folder that
could not be fully deleted, and to report it as an error if it remains
Improved the refusal for a path outside the working directories on macOS and
Windows: when only its letter case differs from a path inside them, the message
names that spelling
Improved the contrast of faint gray secondary text, such as hints, details in
/stats, /model and /sandbox, and rejected-action messages
Improved the artifact database error when an update targets a document that
does not exist, and when the service pauses repeated refused writes
Improved the Claude apps gateway's warnings about a failed upstream call: each
now names the upstream, not only its provider
Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend limit error: it reads "spend limit
reached · resets Dec 1", then admin.blocked_message if one is set
Improved the /model picker: older models are now grouped under a "More
models" row instead of being listed after the current ones
Improved /context at the terminal so the table Claude reads stays short: each
list keeps its 10 largest rows, and MCP tools that load on demand share one row
per server until they're called
Improved /usage in cloud sessions: it now links to Settings → Usage on claude.ai
in a case where plan limits can't be shown
[VSCode] Improved the confirmation for removing a plugin marketplace: it now
checks which of its plugins are installed at that moment
Changed MCP tasks to work in the terminal without feature-flag fetching
(Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, LLM gateways, DISABLE_TELEMETRY); set
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASKS=1 to turn them off
Changed auto mode so that a project's settings files or a plugin can no longer
switch its server-side check back on once you have switched it off outside the
project
Changed Monitor's WebSocket watch to follow a rule on every Bash command: a
deny refuses it, and under an ask rule an allow on Monitor, bypass mode or auto
mode no longer skips the prompt
Changed CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS so that settings files can no longer
set it where the host manages the network; set it in the process environment
Changed a session's exact Bash or PowerShell ask rule to be refused, not asked
about, when a broader deny rule covers the command
Changed the Bash tool to ask for permission before running which with flags
outside a lookup/display set
Changed --add-dir directories to register plugin marketplaces only once that
directory's own trust dialog has been accepted
Changed nested skill loading: with the Bash sandbox on, skills in .claude/skills
folders below the starting folder load only if you start Claude Code there or /cd
there
Changed self-paced /loop to end when a turn finishes without rescheduling,
instead of scheduling a fallback wakeup; set CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE=1 to
keep the old behavior
Changed PostToolUse hooks to run, with up to 10 seconds to finish, on tool calls
that finish after a new message interrupts the turn
Changed what Claude is told after safeguards stop a subagent: retry with a
narrower prompt or tell you, instead of doing the work itself
Changed cloud sessions to drop session-scoped allow rules at a move to a new
worker when their deny and ask rules can't all be kept, so you may be asked
again
Changed the automatic certificate repair behind a TLS-inspecting proxy: it no
longer runs when ALL_PROXY is the only proxy variable set. Set HTTPS_PROXY to
the proxy's http:// URL instead
Changed artifact database saves of rows others may have written: each file gets
a hidden marker file, and existing files without one, earlier versions' exports
among them, are left alone and reported
Updated /claude-api managed-agents-onboard templates to match the Claude
Console: removed Performance tuner, renamed two, and turned off web search
and fetch in five whose prompts don't use them
Self-hosted runner: Changed CLAUDE_RUNNER_CHECKOUT_PATH so that each
repository in a session gets its own folder: a folder name already taken in the
session gets -2, -3, … at the end
[VSCode] Improved the "not signed in" message behind a Claude apps gateway:
it now looks like an error and has a Sign in link
[VSCode] Changed links in Claude's replies that point at Claude sign-in,
connector or API addresses to show as text with the address, instead of
opening in the browser
[VSCode] Improved the chat panel's diagnostics tool for large workspaces: it
leaves out files with no problems, returns compact JSON, and accepts an
optional minimum severity
[Cloud sessions] Improved the stalled-setup warning on self-hosted
environments: its link now prefers your organization's default or an
environment with a live runner, and names it
[Code Review] Changed unlinking a GitHub organization to also turn off its All
repositories setting in Code Review; it stays off after you relink until you turn it
back on
Fixed 90
Fixed MCP servers on the older handshake failing to connect, or returning
empty results, because Claude Code declared an extension that it only uses with
newer servers
Fixed a long-running MCP tool call on a claude.ai connector sometimes never
reporting its result after --resume
Fixed a session's diff failing to load on claude.ai and the mobile apps when the
folder Claude Code runs in has a file or folder named HEAD
Fixed /diff showing "Diff unavailable" when a git repository has a file or
folder named HEAD at its top level
Fixed the /diff pane opening blank in sessions where 64 or more turns edited
files
Fixed slash commands typed after a leading space, tab or newline being sent to
Claude as plain text instead of running
Fixed a request that kept failing with a 401 refreshing your login on every retry
and causing 401s in your other sessions
Fixed /context sending its full visual grid to Claude on every later turn; Claude
now reads only the table
Fixed claude -p exiting 0 in auto mode when its actions were refused because no
safety check was available: text and JSON output now exit 1
Fixed a case where Claude Code listed every project file at start on Linux for
projects on a network file system (NFS, SMB, Lustre and similar)
Fixed a case where auto mode was wrongly refused when a client sent a model
change and a request for auto mode back to back
Fixed /status showing "Auto mode server: Enabled" when the server-side
review isn't reaching the session, for example behind an LLM gateway that drops
it
Fixed Claude-drafted feedback, surveys and /feedback continuing to appear
after the server refused feedback for your organization
Fixed Claude drafting feedback on third-party gateways, where it can't be sent
Fixed auto mode refusing actions without saying why when permission rules or
autoMode settings are very large: it now explains and, unless autoMode deny
rules are set, asks you in the terminal
Fixed a case where Bash deny and ask rules missed commands written with
quoted words
Fixed subagent hand-back reports showing an internal marker and provenance
note when expanded outside verbose mode
Fixed claude -p --resume with a prompt losing a deferred tool call when its MCP
server is missing: the run now exits 1, keeps the call and refuses later input
Fixed a case where text was dropped from informational messages sent to SDK
clients
Fixed a case where Agent SDK hosts got a generic exit-code error instead of a
failed run's own error message when the disk was full
Fixed CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN re-running a turn that was
interrupted in plan mode when the session resumes in another permission mode
Fixed edits to a settings file being ignored when made within a few seconds of
Claude Code writing that file
Fixed a config file left at the legacy name hiding your setup with no warning:
Claude Code now says on stderr when a home holds two config files, and which is
in use
Fixed ~/.claude.json, settings and edited files ending up empty or cut off when
the disk fills during a save in a read-only folder or to a bind-mounted file (one
session saving at a time)
Fixed Write ending the turn as a refusal when it couldn't read the file to
overwrite
Fixed background Bash commands that finish almost instantly losing their output
while being reported as completed
Fixed the Bash tool's diff of changed files missing a file that the command wrote
just before it ended
Fixed a mistyped model name, such as opus-5-5, telling you to update Claude Code
instead of suggesting the model you meant
Fixed a case where NotebookEdit changed the wrong cell when the notebook
changed while a permission prompt was open
Fixed a ~0.5s hang after pressing Enter on the /login success screen: the
dialog now dismisses immediately and the post-login refresh runs in the
background
Fixed Ctrl+G not opening the external editor while typing an "Other" answer to a
question in screen reader mode
Fixed Monitor's WebSocket watch failing with "could not resolve" behind a proxy
when CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS is set and the machine has no DNS of
its own
Fixed claude plugin eval warnings suggesting max: 0 for a tool that must not be
called, which could never pass
Fixed background plugin auto-update not installing a dependency added by the
updated plugin version
Fixed Cmd+click not opening links in Ghostty over tmux in sessions opened from
the agents view
Fixed a mod's hot reload in .claude/skills missing a file that was deleted just
after it appeared, and missing its return
Fixed /rewind failing with "No files were restored" when restoring code to a
checkpoint from before /branch
Fixed the /claude-api skill saying Console web settings don't apply to Managed
Agents sessions, and tightened its credential and permission examples
Fixed needless permission prompts for read-only commands wrapped in a plain
timeout DURATION, such as timeout 30 rg foo
Fixed WebFetch describing claude.ai shared-chat links as empty pages; it now
says shared chats can't be read and to paste the conversation instead
Fixed Artifact database calls being re-sent to artifacts without a database;
errors now say whether republishing helps
Fixed a case where artifact database reads that save to a folder (out_dir)
were refused
Fixed detailed beta tracing not presenting CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT to collectors
that require a client certificate
Fixed the OpenTelemetry claude_code.session.count metric counting Agent SDK
prewarm() processes that were never claimed; a pre-started process now counts
once, when it is claimed
Fixed /clear killing running commands of background agents, teammates and
workflows that keep running, and foreground subagents of background agents
and teammates
Fixed a terminal whose Claude apps gateway sign-in had expired sending
telemetry and managed-settings requests that the gateway refused and logged as
Fixed the agents view appearing to send a reply to a background session waiting
on a permission prompt; the reply now stays in the box with a hint to open the
session and answer
Fixed agent view removing a draft saved by another agent view in the same
directory when exiting
Fixed a case where agent view came back with another agent view's input text
after restarting itself for an update
Fixed the agents view preview cutting off long commands, results and status
lines without an ellipsis, and dropping **, backticks and tags from commands
waiting for approval
Fixed Claude in Chrome reporting the extension as not connected when the
connection dropped mid-action; Claude now checks the page before repeating an
action that may have run
Fixed Remote Control sessions still showing "Limit reached" on other devices
after a usage limit was lifted outside the session
Fixed the file card sometimes missing in the Claude iOS app when Claude sent a
single file
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing with no explanation when the server
keeps refusing to renew model access: the runner now retries sooner and posts
a warning in the session
Fixed /permissions in cloud sessions replying only that it isn't available; it now
says where the session's rules live and how to change them
Fixed cloud sessions losing session-scoped deny and ask permission rules,
such as those a PermissionRequest hook adds, when the session moves to a new
worker
Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the session when you typed three
messages instead of answering its question in a cloud session
Fixed background tasks that keep running after /clear disappearing from the
task list in Claude Code on the web until another task started or ended
Fixed hidden commands appearing in the slash command menu of cloud sessions
on mobile and web
Fixed a case where /rewind could restore or delete a file through a directory
symlink
Fixed a case where a sed command could skip the permission check in
accept-edits and auto mode
Fixed a case where CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1 in managed settings was
ignored behind an LLM gateway when the gateway's URL is set only there and
server-managed settings can't be fetched
Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide
part of a command from permission checks
Fixed a case where deny and ask rules, hook matchers and disallowedTools
entries written with a claude.ai connector's terminal name
(mcp__claude_ai_Slack) were ignored in Claude Desktop (takes effect once
Claude Desktop includes this version)
Fixed a sandbox escape when creating a worktree
Fixed self-hosted runners: --trust-workspace false now also stops hooks in
the repository's settings files and skills from running
Fixed a case where idle background sessions started through a shell-exported
LLM gateway left the gateway after an update
Fixed help links in /status and the auto mode billing notice opening only part of
the address when they wrap
Fixed a case where certificate errors behind a TLS-inspecting proxy persisted
when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC was set. With it set, Claude
Code now makes a TLS handshake with the configured API host after a
certificate failure, through your http:// proxy if one is set; it sends no API
request
Fixed claude remote-control exiting silently with status 0 when a first-run
question gets no answer (scripts, services, batch jobs, Ctrl+C); it now says why
and exits 1
Fixed claude remote-control ignoring a piped y that has no newline after it at
the first-run question; it now counts as a yes
Fixed /rename reporting plain success when the new name could not be saved to
the session transcript; it now warns that the new name may not last
Fixed ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} not being substituted in a plugin-provided
subagentStatusLine command, which can now reference the plugin's own scripts
Fixed claude plugin update and /plugin "Update now" not installing
dependencies added by the new plugin version
Fixed subagents being told after compaction to expect a completion notice for
background agents they neither started nor took over
Fixed a case where a background agent's later report was lost silently: the
notification now says it was refused and how to ask for it
Gateway: Fixed Claude Desktop offering a web search tool that always failed
when every upstream is Amazon Bedrock
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a runner started with --use-anthropic-git-proxy or
--configure-git registering before a failed startup check made it exit; it now
exits first
[VSCode] Fixed prompts over 50,000 characters being cut off silently: the
prompt now stays in the chat box with a notice, and a paste over the limit is
refused with a notice
[VSCode] Fixed a click on the survey or "Report a problem" buttons sending the
unfinished prompt
[VSCode] Fixed cloud sessions opened from the extension's Web tab bringing
back turns that /clear, or Retry or Edit of a typed prompt, had removed
[VSCode] Fixed a deleted session's file coming back when that session was
renamed in the extension
[VSCode] Fixed Claude carrying out an unapproved plan after a window reload:
a step interrupted in plan mode now stops with a notice when the session comes
back in another permission mode
[VSCode] Fixed a possible chat panel freeze when a dropped item's path
contains a very long run of "/" characters
[VSCode] Fixed the claude-vscode.toggleDictation command starting dictation
in every open Claude view at once; it now acts only in the view you are using, and
a second press stops it
[VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down while a reply with many unclosed $$
math fences, each shorter than the last, streams in
[Cloud sessions] Fixed scheduled tasks silently dropping a connector named
memory: runs now keep it, mounted under that name plus a short suffix
[Cloud sessions] Fixed Send now on a waiting message in cloud sessions ending
running background agents; they now keep running
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag setup blocking launch when the channel list
couldn't fully load; admins can now launch without picking a channel
[Claude Tag] Fixed saving auto mode allow rules in Claude Tag admin settings
overwriting another admin's changes; the save is now refused with a message
Removed 2
Removed shortcuts_list and shortcuts_execute, which listed and started
shortcuts saved in the extension, from Claude Code's built-in Claude in Chrome
tools
Self-hosted runner: Removed the end-of-session upload of a session's debug
log; a failed session's log stays on the runner host unless
--remove-session-state is set
All 146 entries → gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/#v2.1.319
